optimizedDescription.value: Pure buildSchema converts validated SchemaYamlData and templates into governed Schema entities with semantic validation.

optimizedContext.value:
# buildSchema

## Rules
- Pure synchronous `buildSchema(ref, data: SchemaYamlData, templates) → Schema` in `domain/services/build-schema.ts`; no I/O.
- `SchemaYamlData` and raw helpers are plain TypeScript, never Zod/infrastructure types.
- Validate artifact IDs `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; array-entry IDs `/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`, length 1–64, unique per array; hook IDs unique across all workflow steps. Duplicate artifacts/steps throw `SchemaValidationError`.
- Template keys must exist. Artifact `requires` references must exist; non-optional artifacts cannot depend on optional artifacts; dependency DAG must be acyclic.
- `requiresTaskCompletion` must be subset of step `requires`; referenced artifact type must declare `taskCompletionCheck`.
- Helpers `buildSelector`, `buildValidationRule`, `buildFieldMapping`, `buildExtractor`, `buildMetadataExtractorEntry`, `buildMetadataExtraction`, `buildArtifactType` recursively convert plain raw data, strip `undefined`; defaults: `optional=false`, `delta=false`, `requires=[]`. `detectCycle` uses DFS.
- Compile checks against active `CheckRegistry`; unknown IDs throw `UnknownCheckError`. Exact duplicate `{ checkId, to, along }` coordinates throw `DuplicateCheckBindingError`.
- Governance comes from definitions/bindings, never check-name prefixes. `allowBindingOverride: false` forbids embedding or changing locked `onFailure`/`skippable`; `allowConfigOverride: false` forbids `config`; `allowDisable: false` forbids `disabled: true`.
- Governance restrictions are monotonic across schema layers, redeclarations, and `merge-schema-layers`; later layers cannot relax locks or clobber declarations.
- Executable `run`/`external` hook `onFailure` accepts only `abort|warn`; invalid values are schema syntax errors.
- Construct `new Schema(name, version, artifacts, workflow, metadataExtraction)`, including `kind`, `extends`, and declared `requiresTaskCompletion`.

## Constraints
- Domain-only, synchronous, no fs/yaml/zod/application/infrastructure/composition imports.
- Templates preloaded; `buildSchema` never reads files.
- Semantic validation failures use specified typed errors; otherwise `SchemaValidationError`.
